claim.claim-text: 1. A blade angle feedback system (200) for an aircraft-bladed rotor (130), the rotor rotatable about a longitudinal axis (A) and having an adjustable blade pitch angle, the system (200) comprising:

2. The feedback system (200) of claim 1, wherein the at least one position marker (202...902) is provided on a feedback device (204) configured to be coupled to rotate with the rotor (130) and to move along the longitudinal axis (A) with adjustment of the blade pitch angle, and further wherein the at least one sensor (212) is positioned adjacent the feedback device (204) and configured for producing, as the feedback device (204) rotates about the longitudinal axis (A), the at least one sensor signal in response to detecting passage of the at least one position marker (202...902).

3. The feedback system of claim 2, wherein the at least one position marker (202...902) comprises a first material having a first magnetic permeability and defining a first magnetic permeability region (506<1>; 604<A>; 704<1>; 804<1>; 906<1>), and at least one second material having at least one second magnetic permeability and defining at least one second magnetic permeability region (506<2>...506<N>; 604<1>...604<N>; 704<2>...704<N>; 804<2>; 906<2>...906<N>) adjacent to the first magnetic permeability (506<1>) region along the axial direction.

4. The feedback system of claim 3, wherein the at least one second material is a second material having greater magnetic permeability than the first material, and further wherein a fine pitch region (804<1>) of the at least one position marker (802) is provided with the first material and a reverse region (804<2>) of the at least one position marker (802) is provided with the second material.

5. The feedback system of claim 3 or 4, wherein the at least one second magnetic permeability region (506<2>...506<N>) comprises a plurality of second magnetic permeability regions (506<2>...506<N>) axially adjacent to one another along the axial direction and having gradually varying magnetic permeability.

6. The feedback system of claim 3, 4 or 5, wherein the first magnetic permeability region (506<1>) is defined at the first end (504<1>) of the at least one position marker (502), and further wherein the at least one second magnetic permeability is greater than the first magnetic permeability and the plurality of second magnetic permeability regions (506<2>...506<N>) have gradually increasing magnetic permeability from the first end (504<1>) to the second end (504<2>).

7. The feedback system of claim 3, 4 or 5, wherein the first magnetic permeability region (506<1>) is defined at the first end (504<1>) of the at least one position marker (502), and further wherein the at least one second magnetic permeability is lower than the first magnetic permeability and the plurality of second magnetic permeability regions (506<2>...506<N>) have gradually decreasing magnetic permeability from the first end (504<1>) to the second end (504<2>).

8. The feedback system of claim 3, 4 or 5, wherein the first magnetic permeability region (604<A>) is defined between the first end (504<1>) and the second end (504<2>) of the at least one position marker (602), and further wherein the at least one second magnetic permeability is greater than the first magnetic permeability and the plurality of second magnetic permeability regions (604<1>...604<N>) have gradually increasing magnetic permeability towards the first end (504<1>) and the second end (504<2>).

9. The feedback system of any of claims 3 to 8, wherein the feedback device comprises a body (508) provided with the at least one position marker (202...802), the body (508) made of a third material having a third magnetic permeability substantially equal to or lower than the first magnetic permeability and lower than the at least one second magnetic permeability.

10. The feedback system of any of claims 3 to 8, wherein the feedback device (204) comprises a body (904) provided with the at least one position marker (902), the body (904) comprising the first material and the at least one second material, and the first magnetic permeability region (906<1>) and the at least one second magnetic permeability region (906<2>...906<N>) each comprising a portion of the body (904) and of the at least one position marker (902).

11. The feedback system of any of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one sensor (212) is configured for outputting the sensor signal as a function of a position of the feedback device (204) relative to the longitudinal axis (A).

12. A method for providing feedback for an aircraft-bladed rotor (130), the rotor (130) rotatable about a longitudinal axis (A) and having blades (134) with adjustable blade pitch angle, the method comprising:

receiving at least one sensor signal from at least one sensor (212) positioned coupled to the rotor (130), the at least one sensor signal produced by the at least one sensor (212), as the rotor (130) rotates about the longitudinal axis (A) and in response to detecting passage of at least one position marker (202...902) provided at the rotor (130), the at least one position marker (202...902) extending along an axial direction, from a first end (504<1>) to a second end (540<2>), and having varying magnetic permeability from the first end (504<1>) to the second end (504<2>); and processing the at least one sensor signal to generate a feedback signal indicative of the blade pitch angle of the rotor (130).
